claims: The Artemis II mission is scheduled to launch on Wednesday, April 1, 2026, at 6:24 p.m. EDT.
The Artemis II mission launch will take place from NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
The Artemis II mission launch has a two-hour window available until 8:24 p.m. EDT.
The Artemis II mission will carry four astronauts around the moon on a 10-day journey.
The Artemis II mission launch location is Launch Pad 39B, Kennedy Space Center, Florida.
The Artemis II mission launch time is 6:24 p.m. EDT (2224 GMT).
Backup launch opportunities for the Artemis II mission exist daily through April 6.
Backup launch opportunities for the Artemis II mission exist on April 30.
If the Artemis II mission launch is delayed, subsequent backup windows start at 7:22 p.m. EDT on April 2.
If the Artemis II mission launch is delayed, subsequent backup windows start at 8:00 p.m. EDT on April 3.
Live coverage of the Artemis II mission is available on NASA's YouTube channel.
Live coverage of the Artemis II mission is available on NASA+.
